create_GaussianUnion: create a GaussianUnion from a list of GaussianModel instances for rasterization
get_xyz_from_GaussianUnion: get concatenated xyz positions from all Gaussian models in a GaussianUnion
get_scaling_from_GaussianUnion: get concatenated scaling tensors from all Gaussian models in a GaussianUnion
get_covariance_from_GaussianUnion: get concatenated covariance tensors from all Gaussian models with an optional scaling modifier
get_rgb_from_GaussianUnion: get concatenated RGB values from all Gaussian models in a GaussianUnion
